description: Two-channel mixer with a fader and a direct out per channel, feeding either a stereo pair of mix outputs or the same mono mix on both

params.text: Sets the level of both mix outputs, silence fully left, 0dB at noon and +6dB fully right
MONO sends the sum of both channels to both mix outputs; ST sends channel 1 to MX 1 and channel 2 to MX 2, and needs both input jacks patched or the mono sum is sent instead
Sets the level of the IN 1 signal, silence at the bottom and +6dB at the top, with 0dB at the default position
Sets the level of the IN 2 signal, silence at the bottom and +6dB at the top, with 0dB at the default position

inputs.text: Scales the level of the mix outputs, 0-10V for silence to the LEVEL setting, with voltage outside that range clamped; the CH direct outs are not affected
The signal into channel 1; a polyphonic cable keeps all its channels
The signal into channel 2; a polyphonic cable keeps all its channels

outputs.text: In MONO the sum of both channels after their faders, the LEVEL knob and the CV; in ST the channel 1 signal alone
In MONO the sum of both channels after their faders, the LEVEL knob and the CV; in ST the channel 2 signal alone
Channel 1 after its fader, taken before the LEVEL knob and the CV input
Channel 2 after its fader, taken before the LEVEL knob and the CV input

notes: In ST both IN jacks must be patched for the mix outputs to be a stereo pair; with one of them empty the mono sum of both channels is sent to both outputs instead.
menu: Smooth level CV — adds a 6ms slew to the CV input, softening abrupt changes of level; it is ticked by default
